title: Exact hearts and cohomology for a t-exact functor on fixed pairs
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be triangulated categories with bounded $t$-structures [def-weil-triangulated-category, def-weil-t-structure], with abelian hearts $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$. Let $P:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ and $Q:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$ be exact autoequivalences, with $P,P^{-1},Q,Q^{-1}$ preserving both halves of the respective $t$-structures. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an exact triangulated functor preserving both halves, with its shift comparison, and let $\alpha:QF\xrightarrow{\sim}FP$ be a natural isomorphism compatible with these shift comparisons. Use the fixed-pair categories of [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], so an arrow $u:(K,\theta)\to(K',\theta')$ satisfies $u\theta=\theta'P(u)$.

The rule $\widetilde F(K,\theta)=(FK,F(\theta)\alpha_K)$, $\widetilde F(u)=F(u)$ defines a functor $\mathcal C^P\to\mathcal D^Q$. The canonical truncation and cohomology comparisons for $P,Q,F$ induce functors on fixed pairs and natural isomorphisms
$$\mathcal H^a(\widetilde F(K,\theta))\xrightarrow{\sim}\widetilde F(\mathcal H^a(K,\theta))\qquad(a\in\mathbf Z).$$
The carrier of this isomorphism is exactly the canonical comparison $\mathcal H^a(FK)\simeq F\mathcal H^a(K)$ characterized by the truncation maps. It intertwines the structures induced by $\alpha$ and $\theta$, is natural in equivariant arrows, and is compatible with composition of such functors and with shift-compatible natural isomorphisms between them.

The full subcategories $\mathcal A^P\subset\mathcal C^P$ and $\mathcal B^Q\subset\mathcal D^Q$ on objects whose carriers lie in the hearts are abelian. Their forgetful functors create kernels and cokernels: for an equivariant $u:A\to B$, the structure on $\ker u$ is the unique isomorphism $P(\ker u)\to\ker u$ whose composite with $\ker u\to A$ is $P(\ker u)\to PA\xrightarrow{\theta_A}A$, and the cokernel structure is defined by its analogous projection equation. The inverses are induced from $\theta_A^{-1},\theta_B^{-1}$ under the kernel and cokernel preservation comparisons for $P$. The restriction $\widetilde F:\mathcal A^P\to\mathcal B^Q$ preserves these kernel and cokernel maps and is exact. No triangulated structure on either fixed-pair category is asserted.

proof.text: Restrict each t-exact functor R to the full ordinary hearts by heartMap, whose objects and arrows are R on carriers. The two t-exactness fields prove preservation of heart objects, and additivity follows from R.map_add. A short exact sequence in the heart extends to a distinguished triangle by shortExact_iff_exists_distTriang. Apply R to that triangle and its specified shift comparison, then apply the same characterization in the target heart. Thus the restriction preserves short exact sequences. Functor.exact_tfae gives preservation of finite limits and finite colimits, without completeness assumptions.

proof.text: Construct explicitly the equivalence from fixedPairHeart t P to IsoAlgebra of the ordinary-heart restriction of P. An object is sent to the same carrier in the heart with its same structure isomorphism, and a map is sent to its same carrier intertwiner. The inverse forgets the heart wrappers; unit and counit have identity carriers. Their naturality and the triangle identity follow on carriers. IsoAlgebra.abelian applies to the exact additive ordinary-heart restriction from the previous step, and abelianOfEquivalence transfers this abelian structure back to the given fixedPairHeart category.

proof.text: Under the explicit equivalence the given fixedPairHeartForget is definitionally the algebra forgetful functor composed with the equivalence. The exact forgetful instances in the adopted EndoFunctor library therefore give its preservation of finite limits and finite colimits. The finite-limit and finite-colimit reflection lemmas apply since the fixed-pair hearts now have those limits.

proof.text: For a given kernel fork c in the ordinary heart, apply the exact restriction of P to obtain a limiting kernel fork of P(u). The structure isomorphisms of A and B define a natural isomorphism of parallel-pair diagrams. IsLimit.conePointsIsoOfNatIso gives the structure kappa on the kernel. Its hom and inverse projection equations give exactly the two equations in the statement. Any competing kappa has the same composite with the kernel inclusion, so Fork.IsLimit.hom_ext proves uniqueness in the ordinary heart and hence on carriers.

proof.text: Dually apply P to a given cokernel cofork and use the same diagram isomorphism. IsColimit.coconePointsIsoOfNatIso gives its structure gamma; its coprojection equations give both the asserted hom and inverse equations. Cofork.IsColimit.hom_ext applied to the mapped cofork proves uniqueness. These constructions work for an arbitrary universal fork or cofork, not merely the chosen kernel or cokernel.
